boundary: 本包覆盖跨项目边界与操作逻辑。各项目内部设计、数据结构、实现决策在其自身仓库的 document/ 目录。

how_to_use.for_agents: Read this manifest, then only the topics relevant to the request. 深入设计不在本包 — 去该项目仓库的 document/ 目录。
how_to_use.for_humans: mkdocs 站点，或 linxira-wiki list / show <topic>

privilege_rules: Never invoke sudo, su, doas, or run0 directly.
Root work goes through linxira-components; Polkit prompts the user for each action.
Read-only commands (list, status, show) never need root.
If authorization is denied, stop and report — do not retry or find another path.
